description: Vertical timeline that renders the lifecycle events of a signing submission (sent, viewed, signed, and so on). Each entry shows a type icon, localized label, timestamp, recipient, and any event metadata, ordered chronologically.

parameters.name: HeaderContent
parameters.description: Host-rendered summary above the timeline (typically the document name, page/size metrics and its current status — the desktop reference's document card). The panel renders it verbatim before the event list; the timeline never invents document data it does not have (Q-S10).

parameters.name: SortDirection
parameters.description: Sort direction of Events. Defaults to SigningTimelineSortDirection.Descending (the newest event first — today's behaviour, Q-S9); SigningTimelineSortDirection.Ascending renders the ceremony in its reading order.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.
